title: Australian music industry rejects ‘divide and conquer’ proposal to give musicians exemption from AI scraping
summary_full: Reported proposal to give musicians special treatment is ‘unworkable’, Aria CEO says, vowing to stand with other creativesGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastThe music industry will not accept an AI carveout deal that leaves other creative sectors behind, rejecting a reported proposal to give musicians special treatment while allowing big tech to train on other copyrighted material – described by David Pocock as a “divide and conquer strategy”.The trade union representing writers and creatives is “alarmed” at a proposal to let AI companies train on Australian data if they buy a permit, an idea also strongly rebuffed by the Coalition and Greens.Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...
